fields.title: Fields

VcitaAPITokenCredential.title: vcita API Token
VcitaAPITokenCredential.x-credential-instructions: As the account owner, open Settings > Integrations > Webhooks > Connect and copy the API token. Paste the token below without the Bearer prefix. It is sent only to api.vcita.biz. Your token's permissions determine which operations are available.

booking_id.description:
Booking (appointment/event) uid. Can be obtained from:
- `GET /platform/v1/scheduling/bookings` (requires Client token)
- `GET /platform/v1/scheduling/appointments` (returns `id` field which is the booking_id)
- Response from `POST /platform/v1/scheduling/bookings` (returns `data.booking.id`)
booking_id.title: Booking Id

event_instance_id.description: Event instance uid. Required only for cancelling event registrations (not appointments).
event_instance_id.title: Event Instance Id

client_id.description: Client uid. Only usable with a Client token. Does not exempt the request from scheduling-form validation: fields marked `required: true` must still be supplied via `form_data.fields`, otherwise the request fails with 422 `FORM_VALIDATION_ERROR`.
client_id.title: Client Id

event_instance_id.description: Event instance uid. Required for event registration (not appointment booking).
event_instance_id.title: Event Instance Id

portal_id.description: Business uid (same as business_id, for portal context)
portal_id.title: Portal Id

service_id.description: Service uid. Required for appointment booking.
service_id.title: Service Id

staff_id.description: Staff uid. Required for appointment booking. Must be one of the service's `providers_staff` (see `GET /platform/v1/services`).
staff_id.title: Staff Id

start_time.description: ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2026-09-16T15:00:00Z"). Required for appointment. Must be a slot where the whole service duration fits - see `GET /platform/v1/staff/availability`.
start_time.title: Start Time

time_zone.description: Default is set to UTC if not provided
time_zone.title: Time Zone

email.description: Email Address. Must be a valid email format (e.g., user@example.com)
email.title: Email

opt_in.description: Marketing email opt-in status. Accepts boolean values (`true` / `false`) or string values (`"1"` / `"0"`). When set to `true` (or `"1"`), the client is opted in to receive marketing emails; when set to `false` (or `"0"`), the client is opted out. This is distinct from `opt_in_transactional_sms`, which controls transactional SMS consent.
opt_in.title: Opt In

opt_in_transactional_sms.description: Whether the client opts in to receive transactional SMS messages.
opt_in_transactional_sms.title: Opt In Transactional Sms

staff_id.description: Staff ID. Reference to the staff member (see staff entity).
staff_id.title: Staff Id

status.description: Use a client status to categorize clients according to their relationship with your business. Valid values: lead, customer, loyal, inactive
status.title: Status

tags.description: The tag system is based on customized labels that you create, so you can sort your data using personalized words, phrases or themes that are meaningful to you and your business
tags.title: Tags

service_id.description: Service uid, to get the form for a specific service. Omit it and the business-level form is returned, which can miss service-specific fields. Accepts a comma-separated list of uids for a multi-service booking (e.g. "vpa6mzkt11f1n2pc,x8enou59f38uy7kb").
service_id.title: Service Id

start_date.description: The start date of the availability window in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (e.g., "2026-03-03"). Must be a valid date string that can be parsed into a timezone-aware datetime.
start_date.title: Start Date

end_date.description: The end date of the availability window in `YYYY-MM-DD` format (e.g., "2026-03-10"). Must be a valid date string that can be parsed into a timezone-aware datetime. The range between `start_date` and `end_date` determines the window for which availability slots are returned.
end_date.title: End Date

staff_ids_array.description: Comma-separated list of staff member UIDs to query availability for (e.g., "j9c1xh0vzvkr2g0g" or "j9c1xh0vzvkr2g0g, abc123def456"). If the value is a comma-separated string, it will be split into an array internally. At least one staff UID should be provided for meaningful results.
staff_ids_array.title: Staff Ids Array

time_zone.description: IANA time zone identifier used to localize the returned availability slots (e.g., "UTC", "America/New_York", "Asia/Jerusalem"). Defaults to "UTC" if not provided. The time zone affects the `start_time` formatting and date grouping in the response.
time_zone.title: Time Zone

aggregate_by.description: Controls how the availability slots are grouped in the response. When set to "date" (the default), slots are grouped by date string (e.g., "2026-03-03"). When set to "staff", slots are grouped first by staff UID and then by date, and the `staff_id` field is removed from individual slot objects.
aggregate_by.title: Aggregate By

booking_instance_id.description: An existing booking instance UID to exclude from the availability calculation. This is useful when rescheduling an appointment — the time currently occupied by this booking will be treated as available. (e.g., "bk_abc123")
booking_instance_id.title: Booking Instance Id

include_dst.description: When set to "true", the returned `start_time` values will include daylight saving time (DST) offset adjustments for the specified time zone. When "false" or omitted, DST adjustments may not be applied.
include_dst.title: Include Dst

show_past_availabilities.description: When set to "true", includes availability slots that fall before the current time. By default ("false"), only future availability is returned.
show_past_availabilities.title: Show Past Availabilities

ignore_min_schedule.description: When set to "true", ignores the business's minimum scheduling notice (the minimum amount of time before an appointment can be booked). Useful for internal tools or admin-level booking where the minimum lead time should not apply.
ignore_min_schedule.title: Ignore Min Schedule

type.description: The type of service to check availability for. "AppointmentService" returns individual appointment slots based on staff schedules. "EventService" returns event instance availability with additional fields such as pricing and interaction details.
type.title: Type

per_page.description: How many items to return per page. Default: 25. Max: 100
per_page.title: Per Page

updated_at.description: Specify the updated_at filter range, available operators for updated_at: gte, lte. example: updated_at[gte]=2019-01-01
updated_at.title: Updated At

per_page.description: How many items to return per page. Default: 25. Max: 100
per_page.title: Per Page

on_behalf_of.description: Business UID to act on behalf of. Required for Directory tokens.
on_behalf_of.title: On Behalf Of

sort.description: Sort results. Available fields: created_at, updated_at, state. Operators: asc, desc. Example: sort=created_at:asc,updated_at:desc
sort.title: Sort

per_page.title: Per Page

address.description: Address. Send `null` or `""` to clear this field if force_nullifying is true.
address.title: Address

email.description: Email Address. Must be a valid email format (e.g., user@example.com)
email.title: Email

force_nullifying.description: If true, allows nullable fields (address, mobile_phone) to be cleared by sending `null` or empty string. Must be boolean true or string "true".
force_nullifying.title: Force Nullifying

mobile_phone.description: Phone Number. Send `null` or `""` to clear this field if force_nullifying is true.
mobile_phone.title: Mobile Phone

opt_in.description: Marketing email opt-in status. Accepts boolean values (`true` / `false`) or string values (`"1"` / `"0"`). When set to `true` (or `"1"`), the client is opted in to receive marketing emails; when set to `false` (or `"0"`), the client is opted out. This is distinct from `opt_in_transactional_sms`, which controls transactional SMS consent.
opt_in.title: Opt In

source_name.description: Source name. Updates the client's source label (e.g., "website", "client_portal", "contact_form"). The new value is reflected in the `source` field on subsequent GET responses. Note: unlike `POST /platform/v1/clients`, this does NOT create or update the underlying source record, so existing `source_url`, `channel`, and `campaign` values remain unchanged.
source_name.title: Source Name

source_url.description: Source URL. Persists the URL on the client record but, unlike `POST /platform/v1/clients`, does NOT update the underlying source record. As a result, the value will not be reflected in the `source_url` field returned by subsequent GET responses (which is read from the source record). To change the visible `source_url`, `channel`, or `campaign` of an existing client, the source record itself must be updated through other means.
source_url.title: Source Url
